novice.0: Use shortcut keys (I, E, S, K, W, M, R, H) to easily open menus.
novice.1: Find and use hidden portals in the map.
novice.2: Press F1-F7 to express various emotions.
novice.3: Use portals to move to other areas.
novice.4: Portals to other areas are displayed in the Minimap as blue circles.
novice.5: Press the Details button to see your stats in more detail.
novice.6: All player characters will be shown as red dots on the Minimap.
novice.8: Press Z to pick up items on the ground, or you can set your own Pick Up key in the Key Settings.
novice.9: Press the Ctrl key to attack and the Alt key to jump.
novice.10: You can buy equipment and potions for your adventure from NPC shops in the game.
novice.11: You can distribute the AP you earn when you gain a level in the Stats window.
novice.12: You cannot switch to different job after your 1st Job Advancement.
novice.13: Double-click an equipment item in your Inventory window, or drag it into the Equip window to equip it.
novice.14: Press W to open the World Map.
novice.15: Press E to open the Equip window.
novice.16: Press I to open the Inventory window to see the items you own.
novice.17: Press M to open the Minimap.
novice.18: Press K to open the Skill window.
novice.19: Press S to look at your character's stats.

novice2.0: There is a shop in every town where you can purchase equipment and potions.
novice2.1: Some items can only be used by a certain gender or class. Double-check before you buy!
novice2.2: Be careful! Death will cause you to lose some EXP after you take your job advancement.
novice2.3: Completing quests will earn you items you can't find in shops.

novice3.0: Passive Skills begin working automatically as soon as you learn them.
novice3.1: To use Active skills faster, drag the icon from the Skill window into one of your quickslots.
novice3.3: Distribute Skill Points in the Skills window.
novice3.4: Be careful! Powerful monsters dwell in the underground dungeons.
novice3.5: Defeating more powerful monsters will earn you treasures not found in any shop.
novice3.6: MP recovers little by little after a set amount of time has passed.
novice3.7: Skills that cost MP cannot be used without MP.
novice3.8: Return Scrolls will get you back to town and back into action much faster than walking.
novice3.9: If you run out of Stars and Bullets, they will not disappear from your inventory.

novice4.0: There are some skills that will not stack with other skills.
novice4.1: Use a variety of skills to beef up your weapons and armor!
novice4.2: Some quests and items have a Fame requirement.

novice5.0: There are some quests that can be completed multiple times.
novice5.1: Some 4th Job skills require Mastery Books to upgrade (Excludes all Cygnus Knights, except Mihile.)

novice7.0: Some items can only be used by a certain gender or class. Double-check before you buy!
novice7.1: You can dash by pressing > -> or < <-.
